form.label: SOC Security Monitoring & Threat Detection Center
form.description: Real-time threat monitoring, lateral movement correlation, and endpoint telemetry analytics

search.query: index=wineventlog OR index=sysmon | stats count by host
index=wineventlog OR index=sysmon host="$selected_host$" | stats count
(index=wineventlog EventCode=4672) OR (index=sysmon EventCode=10 TargetImage="*lsass.exe*") host="$selected_host$" | stats count
index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 host="$selected_host$" | stats dc(IpAddress) as count

panel.title: Panel 1: Failed Logins Over Time (Brute Force Velocity)

search.query: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 host="$selected_host$" | timechart span=15m count by IpAddress usenull=f useother=f

panel.title: Panel 2: Top Attack Sources (By Volume & Target User Accounts)

search.query: index=wineventlog EventCode=4625 host="$selected_host$" | stats count as "Failed Attempts", dc(Account_Name) as "Unique Accounts Targeted", values(Account_Name) as "Account List", latest(_time) as "Last Seen" by IpAddress | eval "Last Seen" = strftime('Last Seen', "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - "Failed Attempts" | head 10

index=wineventlog (EventCode=4625 OR EventCode=4624) Logon_Type IN (3, 10) host="$selected_host$" | eval Target_Host = coalesce(ComputerName, host) | eval Attacker_IP = coalesce(IpAddress, Source_Network_Address) | transaction Account_Name maxspan=10m | where mvcount(EventCode) > 1 AND mvcount(Target_Host) > 1 | search EventCode=4625 AND EventCode=4624 | table _time, Account_Name, Attacker_IP, Target_Host, duration, EventCode | rename Account_Name as "Compromised Account", Attacker_IP as "Attacker IP", Target_Host as "Target Machines", duration as "Duration (s)"

panel.title: Panel 4: Privilege Escalation & Admin Rights Abuse

search.query: index=wineventlog EventCode=4672 NOT Account_Name IN ("SYSTEM", "LOCAL SERVICE", "NETWORK SERVICE", "ANONYMOUS LOGON", "*$") host="$selected_host$" | lookup user_privilege_lookup Account_Name OUTPUT Department, Privilege_Level | where Privilege_Level != "DomainAdmin" AND Privilege_Level != "LocalAdmin" | table _time, Account_Name, Department, Privilege_Level, host, PrivilegeList | rename Account_Name as "User Account", host as "Host", PrivilegeList as "Privileges Assigned"

panel.title: Panel 5: Top Outbound Connections (Sysmon Event 3 C2 Egress)

search.query: index=sysmon EventCode=3 Initiated=true host="$selected_host$" | top limit=10 DestinationIp by Image

panel.title: Panel 6: Security & Sysmon Event Code Distribution

search.query: (index=wineventlog OR index=sysmon) host="$selected_host$" | chart count by EventCode
